description: This file contains unit tests for the SystemHandler class, verifying its behavior for handling system notifications under various scenarios, including authorization, validation, posting notifications, and error handling.

classes.name: SystemHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of SystemHandler's handleSystemNotify method.

classes.name: FakePoster
classes.description: Mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster for testing, simulating authorized posting of notifications.

classes.name: ThrowingPoster
classes.description: Mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster that throws exceptions to simulate failure scenarios during posting.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Tests that system notification handling rejects requests when the poster is unauthorized.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsEmptyNotification
methods.description: Tests rejection of empty or whitespace-only notification fields.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsInvalidRequestObject
methods.description: Tests rejection when the request JSON lacks required fields.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_postsNotification
methods.description: Verifies that a valid notification request results in a successful post and appropriate response.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_trimsAndPassesOptionalFields
methods.description: Ensures optional fields are trimmed and passed correctly to the poster.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnauthorizedWhenPostFailsPermission
methods.description: Verifies that permission errors during posting result in NOT_AUTHORIZED response.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnavailableWhenPostFailsUnexpectedly
methods.description: Verifies that unexpected errors during posting yield UNAVAILABLE response with error details.
